action_taken: Created backend/src/urlshortener/db/schema.sql with utf8mb4 and AUTO_INCREMENT=56800235.
rationale: The numeric id must start at 56800235 so the first Base62 codes are at least 5 characters.

action_taken: Created encoding/base62.py with encode and decode.
rationale: Deterministic ID-to-Base62 encoding avoids hash-collision retries on insert.

action_taken: Created the FastAPI module: pyproject.toml, settings, SQLAlchemy model, repository, service, routes, and exception handlers. Docs URLs are disabled.
rationale: Stage 3C is the HTTP service. Paths and status codes follow PRD.md.

action_taken: Added the mandatory pytest modules for Base62, the service, expiry cleanup, and the API.
rationale: Gate 4 requires those cases on SQLite with the id sequence starting at 56800235.

action_taken: Corrected the expiry-cleanup assertion so it reads rows from a new session after the delete.
rationale: The delete removed the expired row. The first assertion still held the cached object.

action_taken: pytest from backend/ passed 29 tests. coverage.json totals are 302 covered lines and 353 statements.
rationale: Gate 4 requires a green suite and line coverage of at least 0.80.

action_taken: Removed the prod connect argument ssl_mode. PyMySQL 1.2 already prefers TLS and rejects that keyword.
rationale: The first container start failed before it could listen on 8080.

action_taken: Built url-shortener-python-application:latest and started compose. POST /api/v1/shorten returned 201 and GET /short/3QkkP returned 302.
rationale: Stage 6 requires the process to listen on port 8080 against MySQL 8.0.

action_taken: Enabled FastAPI docs at /docs and /openapi.json. Redirect stays include_in_schema false. Prod stays off unless DOCS_ENABLED=true.
rationale: Gate 4 is green and the human signature [APPROVED: yitin] swagger is recorded. FastAPI already serves the schema, so no package was added.

action_taken: Added LegalPathMiddleware and legal_paths. Illegal URLs return the friendly HTML 404 before routing. pytest from backend/ passed 40 tests. coverage.json totals are 361 covered lines and 413 statements.
rationale: Gate 4 is green and the human signature [APPROVED: yitin] Legal paths is recorded. No package and no table were added.
